pages.text: Hold $(thing)Shift$() while releasing to fire a fan of arrows in a wide arc. Each arrow deals fixed damage regardless of your soul energy.$(br2)The soul cost is moderate, making this a practical mid-combat option for dealing with groups of enemies at medium range.

pages.title: Unlocking
pages.text: Place the Soul Bow in a crafting table with $(item)Arrows$() to begin the forging task.$(br2)This task requires dealing a substantial amount of damage with the bow. Check the tooltip for details.
